Boss '''Gew'lek''' was a criminal who ordered a hit on the [[Cavalier Club]]. [[Locara]] objected to the hit, and confronted Gew'lek in his office, demanding monetary compensation. She reinforced her demand with a [[power cane]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
